title: Image understanding: description, extraction and document reading

videos.script: A picture is the oldest way to store information without typing it. Invoices, receipts, labels, screenshots. {{title}} This lesson teaches a program to read them. Three ways, from the narrowest to the widest. {{three}} Optical character recognition reads printed text, and nothing else. You will run Tesseract on a supplier's invoice. {{ocr}} An object detector says where things are and what they are. But only from a fixed list. {{detector}} A vision-language model describes anything, in sentences. It is also the one most able to invent. {{vlm}} On a clean page, Tesseract gets almost every character right. On a bad scan, a twelve becomes a two. {{scan}} So you will measure each one against the truth. You will also make the invoice check itself. The lines have to add up. {{check}} The question to leave with: what is the cheapest tool that reads this picture well enough, and how will I know when it did not? {{end}}
